title: The Mall World is the real world?

classification.theory_summary: Proposes Mall World dreams are a 'real world' where dreamers play an immersive life-simulation game (compared to Rick and Morty 'Roy'), possibly located in an amusement park/arcade due to machine cost/footprint.
classification.skip_reason: No specific dream episode described; only general recurrence and intent to map layout plus speculative theory.

meta.author_theory: Mall World may be the dreamers' 'real world' where they play an immersive life-simulation game (like 'Roy'), potentially housed in an amusement park/arcade as a large machine.

extraction.extraction_notes: Only phenomenological data present: long-term recurrence (about ten years) and the dreamer's repeated attempt to recall/map the layout. No sensory/scene details (light, crowds, specific locations) provided.
